title: Change an H4 headlamp bulb from behind the lamp: tabs into notches by eye, glass untouched, then hook its wire clip
instruction: Fit the new headlamp bulb from the holder into the headlamp and secure it with the wire clip. Hold the bulb by its base only.
context: A motorcycle service technician fits a replacement H4 bulb to a keyed reflector seat and hooks its holder spring to the headlamp bracket. The 2018 Suzuki GSX250R service procedure illustrates this operation with the coupler and dust boot removed. The operator handles the replacement by its cap and keeps the glass clean.
setup: Use a detached 2018 US Suzuki GSX250R headlamp (35100-20K30, service replacement 35100-20K31) and a 12 V 60/55 W H4 P43t-38 bulb. Mount the unpowered housing facing the robot, 400 mm forward of the bases, centred between them and 150 mm above the table, with the wide slot up. The old bulb, rubber boot and connector have been removed. A left-hinged formed wire swings over the flange and its operating end engages a fixed bracket to the upper right. Place the new bulb glass-down in the cup at x 215, y −60 mm. Randomized trials vary cup position by ±10 mm, roll through 360 degrees and clip opening from 95 to 105 degrees. Fit the split collar and 3 mm-wide steel retaining shoe to the stationary left gripper boss using the supplied STEP and mounting notes. The README gives the named starts and physical sourcing.
scoring: Read at the end of the trial (person check in brackets). 0 if at any time the robot touched the glass envelope (video; in sim more than 0.05 N between a robot link and the glass) or the bulb was dropped (video; sim: falling faster than 0.3 m/s with no robot contact). Seated = the flange flush in the rim all round and the bulb cannot be turned (sim: flange front face within 0.4 mm of the seat, radial error at most 0.2 mm, tilt at most 1 deg, roll within 4 deg of the fitted roll, only possible with all three tabs in their notches). 0.25: seated, clip open. 0.5: seated and the clip swung over the flange but not hooked under the catch (a light pull on the clip end frees it; sim: bail within 6 deg of closed), or hooked with a hand still within 3 cm of the bulb or the clip. 1.0 (ends the trial): seated, clip hooked under its catch (a light pull does not free it; sim: bail within 1.2 deg of closed, wire returned laterally, bight physically behind and overlapped by the fixed tab), all four fingertips and the mounted shoe tip 3 cm or more from the bulb and the clip, bulb still for one second (every 480 Hz pose interval below 3 mm/s and 3 degrees/s). Otherwise 0 (bulb in the holder, in a hand, cocked on a tab or out).
reset_notes: Press the wire in and slide it sideways clear of the fixed tab, swing the clip open to the next setup's angle (1 deg scale on the lamp shell), take the bulb out by its cap (gloves) and stand it glass down in the holder turned to the next setup's roll (1 deg scale on the holder rim). Setups run in order 0-4.
fidelity: P43t cap and seat dimensions follow sheets 7004-39-6 and 7005-39-4. Suzuki bulletin 253 identifies the hinge and fixed bracket. A sprung wire must shift sideways and return under the lip. Axial preload is nominally 21 N; lateral force and lip depth await physical measurement. The left gripper carries a removable 50 g contact shoe. Its STEP files, original bench geometry, calibration and YAM asset licenses are documented in the README.
run_limit: 2400 control steps (2 min at 20 Hz). The trial also ends as soon as the score reaches 1.0.
scores: Scripted reference 1.0 in 1,248 steps. Dream-1 (seed 0) scored 0.0 in 2,400 steps. The axial-only press scored 0.25 in 1,314 steps, leaving the bulb seated and the spring unlatched.
